mapping.draft_py:
# Felidar Retreat (FDN), an enchantment (its compiled cast carrier kept, last).
# "Landfall -- Whenever a land you control enters, choose one --
#   * Create a 2/2 white Cat Beast creature token.
#   * Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Those creatures gain vigilance until end of
#     turn."
# Event: ZNR Spitfire Lagac's B7-landfall-trigger (a land you control enters). Modes: Choose(count 1).
# Mode 1: Elder Gargaroth's B5c-bullet-create-token, a 2/2 white Cat Beast (two subtypes, named as
#   Goblin Wizardry's token is).
# Mode 2: M21 Basri's Solidarity's B5b-put-counter (each creature you control), then the grant of
#   Crash Through's B4-grant-trample-eot-you over the same creatures. "Those creatures" are the ones
#   that just got a counter: nothing can enter or leave between the two instructions of one
#   resolution, so "creatures you control" names the same set; a `result` referent would bind only
#   the first of several objects (BACKLOG, "A referent Selector over a register that binds several
#   objects takes the first").
yours = Selector(
    count=QUnbounded(),
    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
    filter=FAnd(
        children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
        ),
    ),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
landfall = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Choose(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        options=(
            A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
                'count': QConst(value=1),
                'tokens': TokenSpec(
                    name='Cat Beast',
                    type_line='Creature — Cat Beast',
                    types=('Creature',),
                    subtypes=('Cat', 'Beast'),
                    power=QConst(value=2),
                    toughness=QConst(value=2),
                    keywords=(),
                    abilities=(),
                    colors=('W',),
                ),
            }),
            Seq(
                steps=(
                    A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
                        'count': QConst(value=1),
                        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
                        'target': yours,
                    }),
                    A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                        'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.VIGILANCE),
                        'duration': DurationEot(),
                        'target': yours,
                    }),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [landfall, compiled[0]]

clauses.clause: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, choose one —
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (landfall trigger, effect Choose count 1); abilities[1] is the enchantment cast carrier

clauses.clause: • Create a 2/2 white Cat Beast creature token.
• Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Those creatures gain vigilance until end of turn.

mapping.notes: Spitfire Lagac's landfall event; Choose(count 1): a 2/2 white Cat Beast token; Basri's Solidarity's counter on each creature you control, then the vigilance grant (until end of turn) over the same ALL selector: no creature can enter or leave between the two instructions, and a 'result' referent would bind only the first object (BACKLOG). Compiled enchantment carrier kept. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: felidar_retreat_counters_and_vigilance_this_turn, felidar_retreat_vigilance_ends_with_the_turn, felidar_retreat_only_your_lands.
